claims.text: The car pulls forward out of the dark.
The reference shows a black sports car on an empty showroom floor; the car has a carbon-fibre body and a live-action, cinematic look.
The car moves in a slow, continuous, straight line forward, with a soft sheen shifting along the bodywork and the empty floor giving the movement a clean stage.
A low engine hum and the soft roll of tyres accompany the movement.

subjects.description: A black sports car with a carbon-fibre body.

description.text: The scene opens on an empty showroom floor in deep shadow, with the black carbon-fibre sports car held at the edge of near-darkness.
Its low body and smooth panels are barely readable at first, while the open floor around it stays clear and uncluttered, stretching away without people or other vehicles.
The car begins to roll slowly forward out of the dark, easing away from the shadowed background and toward the light.

As it advances, the black finish gradually catches the available light, pulling the vehicle’s shape out of the gloom: the long hood, the low roofline, and the carbon-fibre surfaces become clearer with each moment.
The motion is calm and continuous, a steady forward glide rather than a sudden burst.
The showroom remains empty, so the car is the only object in view, and the surrounding floor gives the movement a clean, open stage.

The contrast between the deep shadow behind the car and the growing visibility of its dark body carries the action; the vehicle changes from a shadowed silhouette into a clearly readable black sports car.
Near the end of the shot, the car has emerged far enough for its form to be legible against the floor, though the darkness still clings behind it.
The lighting state favors the requested emergence from dark, while the car’s carbon-fibre body and the live-action cinematic look remain consistent with the reference.
The floor beneath and ahead of the car stays broad and open, so the vehicle’s forward path is unobstructed; there is no clutter to distract from the slow reveal of its shape.
The dark body reads as a single glossy mass at the start, then separates into distinct surfaces—hood, flanks, roof—as more light reaches it.
The car holds a steady forward line rather than changing direction, and the empty showroom makes every shift in its visibility easy to read.
The transition from silhouette to readable form is the main change, and it unfolds across the full duration rather than in a single instant.
The black carbon-fibre sports car begins to roll slowly forward out of the deep shadow, moving across the empty showroom floor.
A low engine hum starts quietly beneath the movement.
As the car advances, the light gathers along its black body, making the low hood and carbon-fibre panels emerge from the darkness.
Tyres roll softly over the showroom floor.
The car is now clearly readable against the open floor, its dark shape separated from the shadow behind it.
The engine hum stays low and steady as the car continues forward.

soundscape: A low engine hum and the soft rolling of tyres on the showroom floor.
